acceptanceCriteria: A test with two import statements on one line records both bindings or emits an unresolved reason; no silent omission.
body: Found in Codex review of the appmap bug lane (2026-10-20). internal/contextindex/eval_dependency.go:51 webImportStatement matches one import per line; `import a from './a'; import b from './b'` records only the first binding, so evidence dependent on b is silently dropped. Expected: every statement bound, or the line marked unresolved (fail-closed, V1-1720 contract).
title: contextindex webImportStatement regex records no binding for a second import statement on the same line
